generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A mutation can persist while a following refresh failure is swallowed, allowing stale UI and contradictory success feedback.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Await a refresh helper but let that helper catch and normalize refresh failures as a successful return.
trigger_signals: success state emitted after a refresh helper
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Separate refresh primitives that propagate failure from user-triggered loaders that render errors; after mutation, branch on refresh outcome before emitting success.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Force a mutation to resolve and the immediate refresh to reject; require visible failure, no success state, and unchanged mutation call count during recovery.

transfer_cases.scenario: destructive mutation succeeds then refresh fails
metadata mutation succeeds then refresh fails

skill_changes.change: Implementation workflow requires the post-mutation refresh failure control before freeze.
Controller adversarial evidence rejects refresh-await-only proof without error propagation and outcome discrimination.
